data.express.serivce_info.content:
Green Express service – Super fast delivery

Service reserved for Customers who require instant delivery.

Total fee to be paid includes the fares displayed on the application and surcharges (if any), as follow:

1. Fare displayed on the application include:
  • Fare for the first 2km: 14,000 VND/km.
  • From the third km onwards: 5,000 VND/km.
  • Fee for special request.
  • Standard weight: 30kg
  • Standard size: 50x40x50 cm

* Flexible pricing is applied subject to demand increases based on area and time of day. The above fares do not include trip insurance.

2. Other surcharges (may) include:
  • Holiday surchage: 5,000 VND/trip - applied according to State holidays.
  • Night surcharge: 10,000 VND/trip - applicable from 10:00 pm to 5:59 am.

* The final price displayed on the application is the amount you need to pay for using the service after deducting promotions/discounts (if applicable), inclusive of VAT .

data.privacydata_detail_body_basicinfo:
Data we process: Full name or display name, language, country/market of use.
Purpose: Identify you when using the service, show the right language, and provide services suitable for your market.
Recipients: Green SM internal teams.
Processing period: As long as you maintain your account.
data.privacydata_detail_body_identity:
Data we process: Phone number, country code, account identifier (user ID), OTP code and verification status, login information.
Purpose: Register, verify your identity, and protect your account; recover your account when needed.
Recipients: Green SM internal teams.
Processing period: As long as you maintain your account.
data.privacydata_detail_body_payment:
Data we process: Amount, payment method, transaction status and code, invoice. Card/payment account information is sensitive personal data — Green SM does not store card number, cardholder name, or CVV; transactions are processed on the bank/payment provider system.
Purpose: Process payments and refunds for your transactions; reconcile records and fulfill accounting obligations.
Recipients: Banks and payment providers related to your transaction.
Processing period: Per transaction; documents are retained according to statutory accounting retention periods.
data.privacydata_detail_body_security:
Data we process: Device ID, operating system, app version, IP address, security risk signals.
Purpose: Protect your account, detect and prevent fraud and unauthorized access; fix technical issues.
Recipients: Green SM internal teams; authorized security solution providers, if any.
Processing period: As long as you maintain your account.
data.privacydata_detail_body_servicedata:
4. Service usage data
Data we process: Pickup point, destination, location during booking and trip/order fulfillment, time, route, service type, driver/vehicle information serving you, order history. Location data is sensitive personal data under applicable law.
Purpose: Find a vehicle and fulfill your trip/order, calculate fares, support you during the trip, and resolve disputes if any.
Recipients: Green SM internal teams; the driver fulfilling the trip (only the information needed to pick you up and serve you).
Processing period: As long as you maintain your account, according to the retention period in the Personal Data Protection Policy.
data.privacydata_detail_body_support:
Data we process: Support request content, complaints, incident information, and evidence you proactively provide.
Purpose: Provide support and customer care, resolve complaints and incidents, and protect your rights and interests.
Recipients: Green SM internal teams; relevant parties when needed to resolve disputes according to law.
Processing period: Until the request is fully handled, plus the legally required retention period.
